definitions.explanation: A clock or watch that automatically synchronizes its time by receiving radio signals from a time standard transmitter, ensuring high accuracy.

examples.japanese: {電波時計|でんぱどけい}は{時刻|じこく}が{正確|せいかく}だ。
{壁|かべ}にかけている{電波時計|でんぱどけい}が{自動|じどう}で{時刻|じこく}を{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: The radio-controlled clock on the wall automatically adjusted the time.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}に{電波時計|でんぱどけい}の{腕時計|うでどけい}をプレゼントした。
examples.english: I gave my father a radio-controlled wristwatch for his birthday.

notes:
A compound of {電波|でんぱ} (radio waves) + {時計|どけい} (clock/watch). In Japan, these clocks receive signals from the JJY transmitter operated by NICT (National Institute of Information and Communications Technology). They are extremely popular in Japan and are a common gift item.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電波時計|でんぱどけい}の{腕時計|うでどけい}: radio-controlled wristwatch
- {電波時計|でんぱどけい}の{掛|か}け{時計|どけい}: radio-controlled wall clock
- {電波|でんぱ}を{受信|じゅしん}する: to receive the radio signal

RELATED WORDS:
- {腕時計|うでどけい}: wristwatch — general term
- {置|お}き{時計|どけい}: desk clock
- {掛|か}け{時計|どけい}: wall clock
- {目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}: alarm clock
